description: New capacity of a CPython list resized to n items: n + n/8 + 6 rounded down to a multiple of 4, or n rounded up to a multiple of 4 when the jump from the old size s is large, 0 for n = 0
notes: CPython 3.13.0, the over-allocation step of list_resize (Objects/listobject.c): Py_SIZE(self) becomes the parameter s and the function returns new_allocated; the early return when the current allocation already fits, and the reallocation itself, are left out. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: shifts, adds, masks, one compare and two selects: 13 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
